system.description:
This is an advanced version of the Shadow Tendrils. You manifest inky black tendrils of shadow that answer your call from your shadow itself. For the duration, you can spend your Action to perform any of the following abilities.

Shadow Drill. Make a melee Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) attack with a range of 10 feet against a creature you can see. On a hit, you deal 5d8 piercing or necrotic damage and the affected creature makes their next Strength saving throw at disadvantage.

Sea of Spears. All creatures of your choice within 10-feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d8 piercing or necrotic damage and are Shadow Bound until the end of their next turn, or half as much on a success.

Shadow Barrier. Select up to two willing allied creature within 30 feet of you. They are encircled by a bubble of spiraling shadows granting them 3d12 + 8 temporary hit points, which last until the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and dice rolled for damage or temporary hit points by +1.
